section Colour Description
text Colour Name
number Colour ID
checkbox Transparent Colour (Editor Only)

section Colour
picker ColourPicker
desc Select a main colour (for editor only) with the picker above.
number Colour R value
number Colour G value
number Colour B value

section Gradient Orientation
number Orientation
desc This template creates custom colours tuned for tile pieces.
desc Proper gradient orientation is necessary for rectangular tiles
desc   with either a portrait or a landscape orientation.
desc Use either 0.0 (portrait) or 1.5708 (landscape),
desc   then rotate the tile in your scene for the stars to be at the top.

section Stars
number Stars
desc Determines the amount of stars are visible.
desc Lower numbers = fewer stars
desc Values lower than 0.0 shows NO stars, there is no upper limit
desc Starting value of 0.5 recommended

section Sky Gradients
number NightSky
number PreDawnSky
number DawnSky
desc Values go from 0.0 to 1.0
desc When NightSky = 0.0 and PreDawnSky = 0.0 and DawnSky = 0.5, Full night sky
desc When NightSky = 0.0 and PreDawnSky = 1.0 and DawnSky = 0.5, Full pre dawn sky
desc When NightSky = 1.0 and PreDawnSky = 0.0 and DawnSky = 0.5, Dimmer dawn sky
desc When NightSky = 1.0 and PreDawnSky = 0.0 and DawnSky = 1.0, Full dawn sky

end of form
